items.title: Last Straws: John Chaffe, Bris Jones, Bill Lee, Frank De La Houssaye, Bob Ice Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: Harry, can you watch the level?

ctx.x: Well, I played a little bit with bands in Boga Loosa, reading bands. And then when I was in the Army, I played with the band, naturally, you know, the dance band. And played around with guys a little bit. But actually, I didn't really start playing with Dixieland until Moose called. I go to school, you know, a GI school, Educational Gateways. And Moose called about a clarinet player. So I met Moose when I started playing with, you know, Moose and Norman and Gene. Norman who? Duripo. Gene Fulon. We got together at…

Excuse me a second. Harry, can you watch the level? What? The level on the machine. So we don't know where it going. Because I want to get a little closer into the mic if we can here. Let's see. And you played saxophone or clarinet?
Yeah, sax. Sax with a dance band, yes. What sax? Well, tenor and alto. I even played baritone. When I was in the army, I played baritone for quite a while.
